scenes.title_cn: 牛奶与奶缸：两个前置选择
scenes.title_en: Milk and Pitcher: Two Setup Choices
scenes.context: 奶泡打发第一关是选料选工具：牛奶首选巴氏杀菌冷藏鲜牛奶，必须冷藏+全脂；奶缸要选打奶缸或全能缸，避免直径最大的拉花缸。
sentences: 我们首要推荐巴氏杀菌的冷藏鲜牛奶。
Our top pick is fresh milk — pasteurized and refrigerated.
pasteurized（巴氏杀菌的）
一定要满足两个非常重要的点：冷藏、全脂。
Two things are non-negotiable: it must be cold, and it must be whole milk.
whole milk（全脂牛奶）
打奶泡尽量去选择打奶缸、全能缸，避免使用拉花缸。
For steaming, stick to a steaming pitcher or an all-rounder — skip the latte-art pitcher.
steaming pitcher（打奶缸）
paraphrase: The best bet is pasteurized fresh milk.
Use a pitcher built for steaming, not for pouring art.
scenes.speak: Our top pick is fresh milk — pasteurized and refrigerated. Two things are non-negotiable: it must be cold, and it must be whole milk. For steaming, stick to a steaming pitcher or an all-rounder — skip the latte-art pitcher.

scenes.title_cn: 原理：进气与打棉两阶段
scenes.context: 奶泡是通过把外部空气搅进牛奶形成的，分为进气与打棉两个阶段：进气让牛奶旋转搅入空气，打棉把大气泡切割成小气泡并均匀分布。
sentences: 奶泡是通过外面的空气搅进去所形成的。
Foam is created by air being folded into the milk.
fold in（搅入）
进气：这个产生的推力，让牛奶旋转起来，把外面的空气搅打进来。
Aeration: the steam's push spins the milk, drawing air in.
aeration（进气）
打棉：通过推力让牛奶旋转、切割，不断形成更小的气泡。
Texturing: the spin and shear keep breaking big bubbles into smaller ones.
texturing（打棉）
paraphrase: First you bring air in, then you refine the bubbles.
The big bubbles get chopped into silky micro-bubbles.
scenes.speak: Foam is created by air being folded into the milk. Aeration: the steam's push spins the milk, drawing air in. Texturing: the spin and shear keep breaking big bubbles into smaller ones.

scenes.context: 实操先定缸的位置：缸嘴贴住蒸汽棒、蒸汽棒在三点钟方向。进气时间按机型：家用机3000-5000元档10-15秒（等蒸汽变强再计时），商用机3-5秒。
sentences: 缸嘴要贴住蒸汽棒，不要让它悬空。
Rest the pitcher's spout against the wand — never hold it in mid-air.
hold it in mid-air（悬空）
蒸汽棒的位置在三点钟。
Position the steam wand at the three o'clock angle.
three o'clock（三点钟方向）
家用机蒸汽是泵加热，由弱到强，要等它变强、有进气声了才开始计时。
Home machines build steam gradually, so start timing only once it's roaring and sucking air.
sucking air（进气/吸入空气）
paraphrase: Keep the wand and spout in firm contact.
「等蒸汽变强再计时」换种说法
Don't start the clock until the steam kicks in.
scenes.speak: Rest the pitcher's spout against the wand — never hold it in mid-air. Position the steam wand at the three o'clock angle. Home machines build steam gradually, so start timing only once it's roaring and sucking air.

scenes.title_en: When to Stop: Temperature and Feel
scenes.context: 打棉停点靠温度判断：理想约65度。手感法：烫手但拿得住约60度，拿不住70度以上，只有温热约50度。打棉期间切记乱动，防二次进气。
sentences: 我们一般理想的状态是达到一个65度左右的牛奶温度。
The sweet spot is around 65 degrees Celsius.
sweet spot（理想状态/最佳点）
烫手但拿得住，这个温度基本上就在60度上下。
If it's hot but you can still hold it, you're around 60 degrees.
hot to the touch（烫手）
埋进去之后就不需要再做任何操作了，二次进气奶泡就基本上没救了。
Once the wand is in, do nothing — re-aeration basically ruins the foam.
re-aeration（二次进气）
paraphrase: You can still grip it comfortably.
Keep your hands off — any fiddling adds air back in.
scenes.speak: The sweet spot is around 65 degrees Celsius. If it's hot but you can still hold it, you're around 60 degrees. Once the wand is in, do nothing — re-aeration basically ruins the foam.

practice.a: It must be cold, and it must be whole milk.

practice.q: 「打奶泡别用拉花缸」怎么表达？
practice.a: Skip the latte-art pitcher for steaming.

practice.q: 「等蒸汽变强再开始计时」怎么说？
practice.a: Start timing only once the steam kicks in.

practice.q: 「打棉期间别乱动，防二次进气」怎么讲？
practice.a: Keep your hands off while texturing — re-aeration ruins the foam.

pitfalls: Use whatever milk is in the fridge, room temperature is fine.
Room-temp or low-fat milk won't build the structure foam needs.
Steam with the same pitcher you use for pouring art.
Use a steaming pitcher or an all-rounder.
A wide art pitcher barely spins the milk, giving uneven foam.
Start the steaming clock as soon as you open the valve.
Wait for the steam to build and start timing then.
Home machines ramp up slowly; early seconds add no real aeration.
Keep nudging the wand during texturing to even out bubbles.
Hold the wand still once it's set.
Every tweak risks re-aeration, and re-aerated foam is ruined.
shifts: 奶泡打不好就多转两下、换换手法
按原料-工具-原理-参数四步找标准，打棉时管住手
